HostsOpenAI & Cerebral Valley
GPT-6 Astra Hackathon SF
San Francisco, CATue, Sep 8 at 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM (PDT)

GPT-6 Astra is here. Come build with it.

This hackathon is for developers, technical founders, and startup teams to build with GPT-6 Astra – the world’s most intelligent and aligned model. Meet the OpenAI team and compete for a chance to demo onstage for a panel of judges (announcing soon). 

Prizes:

1st place - $50,000 credits + DevDay 2026 tickets
2nd place - $25,000 credits
3rd place - $15,000 credits
All finalists - 1 year of ChatGPT Pro

Rules:

Show us what you can ship with GPT-6 Astra's new capabilities, whether that’s something new or a feature for your existing startup. All work must be built during the hackathon and submitted as a public open source repository - existing product code does not qualify.

Applications reviewed on a rolling basis & space is limited. Maximum teams of four. All attendees must submit an application to be approved.

Please note: This event is fully in-person in San Francisco. Capacity is limited. Teams may have up to four members. All attendees must apply and be approved. Submitting an application does not guarantee a seat; approved applicants must confirm their attendance.

Register

The Agent Arena Hackathon
San Francisco, CASep 26 at 9:00 AM – Sep 27 at 5:00 PM (PDT)

Join us at The Agent Arena Hackathon hosted by Vultr to build what the next generation of agent infrastructure actually looks like in production.

Agents are writing code, driving browsers, and running real operations for teams. The infrastructure built to contain and coordinate what they do needs to get better.

Vultr is bringing the tools for you to build infrastructure powering the next generation of autonomous execution: VM backends, serverless inference, and the compute layer agents run on when they stop talking and start acting.

Compete for more than $10,000 across cash and credits!

Note: This event is fully in-person in San Francisco. Teams may have up to four members. All attendees must apply and be approved. Submitting an application does not guarantee a seat; approved applicants must confirm their attendance.

About Event

​Build, deploy, and scale with Runpod—from anywhere.

​From October 23 - October 30, join builders around the world for a six-day online hackathon focused on creating ambitious AI applications with Runpod’s cloud infrastructure.

​Whether you’re building an inference API, AI agent, generative media workflow, fine-tuning pipeline, or an entirely new developer tool, this is your opportunity to turn an idea into a working project. Participants will have time to build remotely, connect with the Runpod team and community, and compete for cash prizes and platform credits.

​What we’ll explore:

​GPU-powered AI applications and workflows

​Serverless inference and scalable endpoints

​Model training, fine-tuning, and deployment

​Production considerations including performance, reliability, observability, and cost

​Creative uses of Runpod across agents, media, developer tools, and more

​Prizes: over $10,000 in prizes!

​Additional prizes will be awarded across bonus categories.

​If you’re an AI engineer, developer, researcher, or technical founder looking to ship something real with powerful GPU infrastructure, this hackathon is for you.

​Join online, build from anywhere, and show us what you can create with Runpod.
